content.text:
That's the end. "אתר אישי, לא מסחרי". So it isn't a bank or anything official. Whose site is it? "מקור" means nothing to me.

**To my son:**
"Listen, I didn't decide anything. I'll go to the bank and ask, and I'll ask you too. I'm fairly sure about one thing: the money sitting in my עו"ש doesn't earn anything. The page says so: 'כסף שיושב בעו"ש בלי ריבית לא גדל'. It also says that if more than 15,000 ₪ stays in there for a whole quarter, the bank has to send me a letter. Nobody ever sent me one. That's the first thing I'll ask the clerk.

What does it cost me? The page didn't say. Under 'כמה זה עולה' there's no number at all, only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'. So I still don't know.

What else could I do with it? All it offers is 'מזומן שקלי' and 'קרן כספית', and I don't know what a קרן כספית is. There was a nice graph showing 74,044 ₪ after ten years 'בתשואה של 5%'. But is that my עו"ש? My bank never paid me 5%. I didn't trust it.

And then it frightened me. There's a red box with a lock, and it says 'אין בישראל ביטוח פיקדונות' and that the 250,000 ₪ guarantee doesn't cover money in the עו"ש. Is my money not safe? After that came more red locks, 'חסום', 'TXI OQ11', 'BANK-23'. I don't know what any of it is. At the very bottom it turns out to be 'אתר אישי', not a bank. So I won't act on it. Let's go to the bank together."

**Short account:** I read the top part and the explanation, glanced at the graph, and read the cost and tax sections and the risk section. I skimmed the word table and didn't touch the sliders or the folds. Things I didn't understand: קרן כספית, מק"מ, BANK-20/23/15, TXI OQ11, BANK OQ9, "חסום", "מאיפה זה", and "מסלול מורחב". The grey writing on the black background was hard to read, especially the small print under the graph and in the tax cards. What worried me was the red box and the line about there being no deposit insurance.
